subject: general
question: Find the value of: (sqrt{625} - sqrt{81}) times (sqrt{49} + sqrt{121})
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute the **square roots**: (25 − 9) × (7 + 11)

⇒ 16 × 18

Apply the **middle-term square trick**: 17² − 1 = 289 − 1 = 288.

**∴ The correct answer is 288.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (√625 − √81) × (√49 + √121)

**Formula Used:** **BODMAS** (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ √625 = 25

⇒ √81 = 9

⇒ √49 = 7

⇒ √121 = 11

⇒ (25 − 9) × (7 + 11)

⇒ 16 × 18

⇒ 288

**∴ The correct answer is 288.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Squares Table

Memorizing squares up to 30 is essential for **banking exams**. Key values: 25² = 625, 11² = 121, 9² = 81, and 7² = 49.

BODMAS Rule

Operations inside **brackets** must be completed before performing multiplication outside the brackets.

Algebraic Identity for Multiplication

The product of two numbers (x − a) and (x + a) is always x² − a². Here, 16 × 18 = (17 − 1)(17 + 1) = 17² − 1².</p
